name: LibraryLayout
summary: A screen with a header, a navigation region, a main region and an optional side pane, for catalogue-style apps. Not for single-task screens or dialogs; use a focused layout there.
a11y: Renders a skip link, then `header`, `nav` (named by `navLabel`), `main` and, when given, a complementary `aside` named by `asideLabel`. Regions scroll edge to edge; padding sits on their content, so focus rings are never clipped. The pane never traps focus: below breakpoint.md it covers at most the lower part of the screen and main keeps room to scroll past it. With `pageKey`, a page change fades main's content out, puts main back at the top, then fades the new page in (100 + 100 ms, instant under reduced motion); header, navigation and pane never fade. The fading page takes no pointer input. Focus moves to the new page's `h1`. From breakpoint.md a handle on the navigation's end edge resizes it (a window splitter: `role="separator"` with its width as the value, 24 px wide, invisible until hovered, focused or dragged); the width stays between `size.nav-width-min` and `size.nav-width-max` and is remembered under `navWidthKey`.

keys.keys: Tab from the top of the page reaches the skip link first; Enter moves focus to main
keys.action: Tab from the top of the page reaches the skip link first; Enter moves focus to main.

props.name: header
props.description: Product identity, version and global status.

props.name: nav
props.description: Navigation for the whole app; scrolls on its own from breakpoint.md.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation region.

props.name: aside
props.description: An optional working pane beside main (a revision or inspector pane). Beside main from breakpoint.md, a bounded sheet over the bottom of the screen below it; never a modal.

props.name: asideLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the pane; required with `aside`.

props.name: skipLabel
props.description: Visible-on-focus link that jumps past header and navigation.

props.name: pageKey
props.description: Identity of the page in `main` (a route). When it changes, main's content fades out completely (`duration.page-out`), main returns to the top at once while nothing shows, the new page replaces it and fades in (`duration.page-in`); focus moves to the new page's `h1`. Without it, `main` swaps in place.

props.name: onPageShown
props.description: Called once the page named by `pageKey` is in place, at the top and fading in (and on first render).

props.name: navWidthKey
props.description: Where the navigation's width is remembered in this browser (a `localStorage` key). Without it the person can still resize the navigation, but the width resets on reload.

props.name: navResizeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the handle that resizes the navigation.
